issues.description: Animal.name type is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement requires storing the name as a StringBuilder (for frequent modifications), but the reference solution implements `private String name` with `getName(): String` and `setName(String)`. This contradiction can cause students to implement a different field type and accessor signatures than what the solution/tests likely expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts on a single representation: either (a) change the problem statement to require `String name` (and keep solution as-is), or (b) change the solution (and tests) to use `StringBuilder name` and clearly define accessor behavior (e.g., `getName()` returns `name.toString()`, `setName(String)` replaces contents).
